description: Abstract class defining common behavior for long-running stream actors with status reporting, including configuration management, stream control, event logging, and health reporting.

classes.name: AbstractBackgroundStreamingActorWithConfigWithStatusReport
classes.description: Abstract actor class managing long-running streams with configuration, event logging, health reporting, and stream control.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Interface for events reported by the actor.

classes.name: WokeUp
classes.description: Event indicating the actor has woken up, with enabled state.

classes.name: StreamTerminated
classes.description: Event indicating stream termination, with status level and message.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: Constants defining JSON field names for status reports.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates the actor's message handling behavior, starting in sleeping state.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns current configuration as a Config object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the actor's configuration and schedules wake-up if enabled.

methods.name: sleeping
methods.description: Defines behavior when actor is sleeping, handling wake-up, config, health, and shutdown messages.

methods.name: streaming
methods.description: Defines behavior during active streaming, handling stream events, health, and shutdown.

methods.name: wokeUp
methods.description: Handles wake-up event, possibly restarting stream based on config.

methods.name: streamTerminated
methods.description: Handles stream termination, logs event, and schedules restart if enabled.

methods.name: getEventStream
methods.description: Returns a stream of logged events.

methods.name: scheduleWakeUp
methods.description: Schedules a wake-up event after a specified duration.

methods.name: shutdownStream
methods.description: Terminates the current stream and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: addCustomEventToLog
methods.description: Adds an event to the event log.

methods.name: restartStream
methods.description: Restarts the stream, handling kill switch and stream completion.

methods.name: shutdownKillSwitch
methods.description: Shuts down the current kill switch if active.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Responds with current health status report.

methods.name: renderStatusInfo
methods.description: Builds status info object including most severe event level.

methods.name: getMostSevereLevelFromEvents
methods.description: Determines the highest severity level among logged events.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds JSON status report including enabled state and events.

methods.name: renderEvent
methods.description: Converts an event to JSON format.
